sources_tested: Direct inspection of the DFHG FHG-3 Menodotus Perinthius vel Samius XML; local licensed Perseus Athenaeus XV.12 and XIV.70–71 witnesses; edition/concordance check against Canon FGrH 541.
open_text_result: The FGrH compilation itself is not supplied as an open transcription. DFHG openly transcribes the older FHG dossier (Menodotus Perinthius vel Samius) and identifies the Samian work Τῶν κατὰ τὴν Σάμον ἐνδόξων ἀναγραφή; licensed Athenaeus preserves direct quotations, including XV.12 (671f–672) and XIV.70 (655a–b). These witnesses make individual passages reusable but do not by themselves prove a complete FGrH-541 concordance.
